page.title: Automations, Notifications & Lead Routing
page.description: Discover how to eliminate manual tasks by deploying automated property alerts, seamlessly routing direct leads to your staff, and leveraging advanced system notifications to maintain a flawless, high-velocity sales pipeline.
page.body:
Automations & Lead Routing: Streamlining Your Workflow

In a high - velocity real estate market, manual data entry and delayed response times are critical liabilities. The PropertyList infrastructure is engineered to transform your daily workflow with advanced software and automation.

By deploying smart operational rules, instant notifications, and efficient lead routing, your agency can ensure that no prospect falls through the cracks and every opportunity is instantly actioned by the correct team member.

Core Strategic Capabilities

The platform equips your agency with robust tools designed to automate client nurturing and streamline team management:

  • Tailored Property Alerts: Why waste valuable time manually searching for properties when you do not have to? The platform streamlines your resource optimisation by enabling you to create detailed client profiles equipped with automated, tailored property alerts. When a matching mandate hits the MLS, your system automatically works to notify the client.
  • Intelligent Lead Routing: Whether you are generating direct MicroSite leads, public Portal leads, or internal MLS leads from co - broking professionals, the infrastructure allows you to instantly convert a raw lead into a saved contact. From there, administrators can strategically assign the contact to a specific staff agent, ensuring immediate accountability and rapid response times.
  • System Notifications & ReQuests: Maintain total oversight of your communication pipeline. The ecosystem effectively tracks incoming Agent ReQuests and Client ReQuests, generating internal notifications so your assigned staff can react to inquiries immediately.
  • Advanced Funnels & Nurturing (Coming Soon): We are continuously expanding our technological frontiers. Prepare to deploy advanced AI funnels, AI chatbots, and automated client nurturing systems designed to maximise your overall lead quality with zero manual effort.

Step - by - Step: Automating the Client Journey

To ensure a frictionless transition from initial inquiry to an active, automated property search, execute this rapid workflow within your digital headquarters:

  1. Step 1: Capture and Convert As new direct leads flow into your dashboard via your MicroSite or the public portal, utilise the CRM tools to seamlessly convert the inquiry into an official contact profile.
  1. Step 2: Assign Accountability Navigate to the newly created contact profile and strategically assign the contact to a dedicated staff agent. This establishes a clear chain of command, ensuring the correct team member assumes ownership of the deal and receives all relevant future notifications.
  1. Step 3: Deploy Automated Alerts Within the client's profile, set up highly specific MLS property alerts based on their exact buying or renting criteria. The infrastructure will now take over, continuously scanning the market and automatically dispatching relevant inventory directly to the prospect on your behalf.
Stop losing deals to slow response times. Leverage the PropertyList automation infrastructure to route leads instantly, deploy alerts, and keep your entire team operating at maximum efficiency.
